title: On this day in space! Nov. 13, 1971: NASA's Mariner 9 becomes 1st spacecraft to orbit Mars, revealing close looks at the Martian surface
caption:
In 1971, NASA's Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to orbit another planet. Its findings completely changed our understanding of the Red Planet.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Nov. 13, 1971: NASA's Mariner 9 becomes 1st spacecraft to orbit Mars, revealing close looks at the Martian surface
